recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: medical journals choosing gentler words for hard diagnoses
tropical storm Lala pushing rain through Hawaiian valleys
karl-the-fog sitting over the bay at fourteen degrees
late-summer dusk still hours away in san francisco

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Hold a mason jar open beneath drifting fog wisps on an overcast summer morning — seal captures before they dissolve into the gray.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: hold/release to open and close the jar while collecting falling fog beads
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: hold to open jar mouth, release to seal a capture
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: one jar fills with glowing condensation in under a minute if your timing is clean
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: wind shears wisps into faster diagonal streaks and smaller targets
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: frosted glass minimalism, soft gray gradients, muted bay blues

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Rhythm-tap shipping labels onto a pre-dawn conveyor before sunrise floods the warehouse floor with light.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: rhythm tap on beat markers as crates roll past
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: tap in time with pulsing beat cues
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: nail one flawless shipping streak before the sun crests the horizon
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: BPM climbs and beat windows shrink with each crate cleared
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: warm amber warehouse glow against cool pre-dawn blue

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw one continuous wire from an iOS shortcut icon through GitHub Actions nodes to a pulsing CLI terminal — complete the agent chain without crossing lines.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.mechanic: path drawing puzzle connecting spawn nodes in order
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to draw a single unbroken connection path
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: wire up one working agent pipeline in under sixty seconds
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: new nodes spawn mid-draw and existing paths begin to fade
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: neon blueprint on dark terminal green, phone-screen scale

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Swipe between runoff channels as flash-flood water surges down Hawaiian gulches — stay ahead of the rising tide without getting swept sideways.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: lane switch through branching water channels
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: swipe left or right to jump channels
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: one clean downhill run from ridge to coast before the water catches you
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: channels narrow, merge suddenly, and debris blocks alternate routes
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: saturated tropical greens, muddy browns, rain-streaked glass overlay
